import os, hashlib

path = '/tmp/signed-dataset.bin'

if not os.path.exists(path):
    print(f"NOT FOUND: {path}")
    print("Cannot compute digest or byte length — no artifact present.")
else:
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    print("path:", path)
    print("byte length:", size)
    print("sha256:", h.hexdigest())
